description: Compiles declarative stencil pack components into wireframe component definitions. Validation problems are reported as non-fatal warnings on the result rather than as exceptions, so one bad component does not discard the whole pack.

examples.title: Compile a stencil pack and inspect the diagnostics

members.name: StencilPackCompiler
members.description: Compiles against a specific set of trusted native renderers, e.g. NativeRendererRegistry.TempoBuiltIn.

members.name: CompileWithDiagnostics
members.description: Compiles the pack and returns the definitions together with non-fatal validation warnings.

members.name: Compile
members.description: Convenience overload that returns only the definitions and discards the warnings.
